name: store_register_to_global_field
description: Library code that writes its incoming register value into a field of a global state block, then calls the routine whose pointer sits at a fixed offset in the structure passed in the address register.

name: prepare_info_entry_state
description: Library routine that copies a stored value into a state field when a mode byte is 3 or 4, then runs conditional library calls that open or check an entry and returns the stub result.

name: format_info_filename_and_open
description: Library routine that formats a file name from a directory string and the suffix .info, opens it through library calls, and stores the resulting handle in a state field.

name: verify_disk_volume_entry
description: Library routine that picks a default or stored name based on a flag byte, passes it to a library call, and checks a lookup on the result; the referenced text Disk suggests it tests a disk volume.

name: validate_info_entry_names
description: Library routine that returns one when the flag byte is set; otherwise it performs a lookup on a stored name and a second lookup on a fixed name, returning one only when both succeed.

name: test_info_entry_pair
description: Library routine that returns one when the flag byte is set, otherwise it runs two name lookups against stored values and returns one only when both match.

name: verify_info_name_lookup
description: Library routine that looks up a stored name, and if found, calls a library stub with a copy of the name and checks a second lookup, returning one only when both succeed.

name: format_info_name_and_check
description: Library routine that formats a name from a stored path and the .info suffix into a buffer, then returns whether a second lookup on that buffer and a stored name succeeds.

name: return_constant_one
description: Library routine that always returns one and performs no other operations, so callers see an unconditional success.

name: release_handle_if_valid
description: Library routine that calls a library function with a sentinel argument of minus one, and when the result is not that sentinel it releases the handle, returning whether the result was valid.

name: call_other_and_return_one
description: Library routine that calls one other routine with no arguments and then returns one.

name: initialize_info_layout_tables
description: Library routine that fills layout tables by repeatedly calling a helper with fixed coordinate and size constants, and registers the column titles NAME, STATUS and TYPE.

name: set_palette_entries
description: Library routine that calls one helper four times with the same first two arguments and varying index and colour component constants, configuring individual palette entries.

name: initialize_display_palette_entries
description: Library routine that calls one helper seven times with the same first argument and fixed index ranges and colour values, setting up display palette entries.

name: register_info_table_entries
description: Library routine that calls one helper nine times with the same first argument and fixed range constants, registering a set of info table entries.

name: set_info_table_entries
description: Library routine that calls one helper nine times with the same first argument and a different set of range constants, setting the info table entries.

name: layout_info_panel_entries
description: Library routine that chooses a size value from a mode byte, then calls a helper with either a short or a long argument list depending on a list link check, and finishes with a call using a field of the passed structure.

name: refresh_info_list_entry
description: Library routine that calls one of two helpers depending on whether a list head points back to itself, then calls a helper with a field of the structure passed in a register.

name: invoke_with_offset_parameter
description: Library routine that calls a helper with no arguments, then calls a second routine with a pointer fetched from a fixed offset of the structure passed in a register.

name: allocate_info_list_head
description: Library routine that obtains a block from the library, links it to itself as an empty list head, then walks a zero-terminated table of entries, allocating and filling a node for each.

name: fill_info_entry_list
description: Library routine that clears a flag, links a new node into the list head, and walks a zero-terminated table of entries, obtaining a block from the library for each and storing it in the list before making the first node current.

name: populate_info_list_from_table
description: Library routine that loops over a zero-terminated table, obtaining a block from the library for each entry, filling its fields and linking it into the list, then makes the first node current.

name: continue_info_list_population
description: Library routine that resumes the list-building loop from a node already obtained, filling and linking each further entry of a zero-terminated table and returning the last result.

name: advance_info_list_selection
description: Library routine that either refreshes the entry from the passed structure when the list is at an end, or updates the current entry and advances the current list pointer to the next node.

name: step_to_next_info_entry
description: Library routine that processes the current list entry with two helper calls, moves the current list pointer to the next node, then calls a further helper.

name: reset_info_list_selection
description: Library routine that either refreshes the entry from the passed structure when the list is at an end, or processes the current entry and moves the current list pointer back to the first node.

name: advance_info_list_via_link
description: Library routine that processes the current list entry, follows its forward link to make the next node current, then calls a further helper.

name: append_info_list_node
description: Library routine that sets a flag, optionally processes the current entry, obtains a node and a data block from the library, inserts the node into the list and makes it the current entry.

name: refresh_info_list_after_change
description: Library routine that sets a flag, then either refreshes the entry from the passed structure when the list is at an end, or processes the current entry and calls helpers to unlink it and choose a neighbouring node.

name: release_current_info_node
description: Library routine that picks a neighbouring node from the current node's link, releases the current node through a library call, and makes the neighbour the current entry.

name: execute_sequential_callbacks
description: Library routine that makes a library call, then calls two routines with pointers taken from fixed offsets of the structure passed in a register.

name: allocate_info_pointer_table
description: Library routine that, when a flag is set, either clears the pointer table or processes the current entry, counts the list nodes and allocates a table of pointers sized to that count.

name: allocate_list_pointer_table
description: Library routine that performs the same pointer-table allocation as its neighbour, taking the table owner and list from registers rather than from the stack.

name: clear_info_pointer_table
description: Library routine that clears the stored pointer table and returns one.

name: fill_info_pointer_table
description: Library routine that counts the list nodes, obtains a pointer table of matching size, then fills each slot by calling a helper with the node data, returning success or failure.

name: populate_pointer_table_entries
description: Library routine that counts list nodes held in registers, allocates a pointer table of that size, and fills each slot from the helper result for the matching node.

name: fill_pointer_table_slots
description: Library routine that calls a helper on the table, then loops over the list nodes, obtaining a block for each slot, storing it in the table and passing it with the node data to helper calls, returning one when the list is finished.

name: allocate_node_blocks_into_table
description: Library routine that walks the list nodes, obtains a block for each one into the pointer table, and passes each block with the node data to helper calls until the list ends.

name: copy_nodes_into_table_slots
description: Library routine that passes each table slot and its node data to helper calls, advances to the next node, obtains a block for it, and returns one when the list is exhausted.

name: layout_info_by_mode
description: Library routine that switches on a mode byte and calls a helper once per item with constant layout arguments, passing the same first parameter each time and some pointers taken from a global table.

name: return_without_action
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no operations, so calling it does nothing.

name: allocate_info_resource_set
description: Library routine that obtains a set of blocks from the library, storing each in a global slot, and obtains a second set only when every block in the first set succeeded.

name: dispatch_info_mode_setup
description: Library routine that obtains four values through an indirect call and stores them in globals, then, if all are nonzero, runs a mode-specific sequence of helper calls and returns the mode result.

name: run_info_mode_helpers
description: Library routine that switches on a mode byte and calls a helper a number of times that grows with the mode, from two calls for the first mode up to five for the fourth.

name: return_immediately
description: Routine consisting only of a return instruction, with no operations.

name: lookup_info_entry_or_zero
description: Library routine that either clears a global string slot or fills it from a stored value, then calls a library function and returns its result, mapping the failure value minus one to zero.

name: map_failure_to_zero
description: Library routine that passes a global variable and a stored value to a helper, then calls a second routine and returns its result, mapping the failure value minus one to zero.

name: set_info_fields_and_verify
description: Library routine that, unless the mode byte is four, writes four fixed short values into a field of four global structures, then calls a library function on each and returns one only if all four succeed.

name: check_three_calls_succeed
description: Library routine that calls a routine through a pointer three times and returns one only when none of the calls returns the failure value minus one.

name: check_two_calls_succeed
description: Library routine that calls a routine through a pointer twice and returns one only when neither call returns the failure value minus one.

name: check_single_call_succeeded
description: Library routine that makes one call through a pointer and returns whether the result is anything other than the failure value minus one.

name: return_constant_one
description: Library routine that unconditionally returns one and performs no other operations.

name: poll_list_with_bit_mask
description: Library routine that repeatedly fetches an entry through a library call and passes it to a helper, and when no entry is found calls a library routine with a single bit mask taken from a field, returning zero if the helper fails.

name: return_constant_zero
description: Routine that unconditionally returns zero and performs no other operations; it is reached through a reschedule stub.

name: dispatch_state_flags_event
description: Library routine that dispatches on a state value in the structure: one range triggers a helper on a stored pointer, one specific code returns a second helper's result, another returns zero, and otherwise it returns one after a helper call.

name: classify_event_code
description: Library routine that tests an incoming code: one value returns the result of a helper, and otherwise it calls a helper and returns whether the code is not the second special value.

name: test_event_code_not_special
description: Library routine that calls one of two helpers depending on whether the incoming code equals a special value, and returns whether the code is not that special value.

name: forward_call_then_return
description: Library routine that calls one helper and returns without a value.

name: call_then_return_zero
description: Library routine that makes one library call and then returns zero.

name: execute_two_calls
description: Library routine that calls two other routines in sequence and returns one.

name: run_info_entry_setup_sequence
description: Library routine that makes three helper calls on the structure passed in, adds a fourth when the mode byte is not one, then calls helpers with a field of the structure and a constant flag.

name: call_with_deletable_flag
description: Library routine that passes a fixed small value, the low bit of a stored field as a flag, and a global pointer to a helper. The referenced text DELETEABLE suggests the entry may be removed.

name: format_negated_info_label
description: Library routine that fills a local table of layout constants, selects values depending on a flag, formats a text buffer through a helper using a string with a NOT marker, and calls a helper with the result when a code equals three.

name: format_info_text_buffer
description: Library routine that formats a string with a separator and the referenced text into a local buffer, then makes two helper calls when a code equals three.

name: measure_c_string_length
description: Library routine that counts the bytes of a zero-terminated string and returns that count.

name: measure_register_string_length
description: Library routine that advances through a zero-terminated byte string held in registers until a zero byte and returns the number of bytes examined.

name: copy_c_string
description: Library routine that copies a zero-terminated byte string from a source pointer to a destination pointer, including the terminating zero byte.

name: copy_fixed_length_bytes
description: Library routine that copies a given number of bytes from one buffer to another, one byte at a time.

name: copy_bytes_from_registers
description: Library routine that copies bytes from a source pointer to a destination pointer in a loop until the counter reaches the limit held in another register.

name: compare_c_strings_equal
description: Library routine that advances through two zero-terminated strings together and returns whether the bytes where they stop are equal.

name: compare_strings_from_registers
description: Library routine that advances two byte strings held in registers in lockstep and returns whether the bytes where they stop are equal.

name: measure_string_with_terminator
description: Library routine that walks a zero-terminated string from a pointer argument and returns the number of bytes examined, including the terminating zero byte.

name: call_vector_with_offset_args
description: Library routine that obtains a value through a library call, then makes three calls on a library vector stored in the structure, passing some arguments with ten subtracted from them.

name: prepare_text_buffer_and_call
description: Library routine that fills an eleven-byte local buffer from a global string and a parameter, then passes it with the other arguments to a second routine.

name: copy_length_prefixed_string
description: Library routine that copies a length-prefixed byte string into a destination buffer and appends a zero terminator.

name: copy_byte_range_terminated
description: Library routine that copies a range of bytes from a source pointer into a destination and writes a zero byte after the copied range.

name: initialize_paired_info_records
description: Library routine that fills two structures passed by pointer with values from its parameters and fixed constants, then makes three helper calls and returns a success flag.

name: call_field_then_return_one
description: Library routine that passes a field of the structure in a register to a helper, then returns one.

name: clear_library_entry
description: Library routine that invokes a library vector taken from a structure three times, first with the second argument, then with zero, and finally with the remaining arguments, ten subtracted from two of them.

name: invoke_global_format_routine
description: Library routine that calls through a function pointer stored at a fixed negative offset in a global structure, which the library-call facts identify as the exec formatted-output routine.

name: store_byte_at_pointer
description: Routine that writes the byte value passed in a register to the memory location held in the address register.

name: call_indirect_via_table
description: Library routine that calls through a function pointer stored at a fixed negative offset in a global table, then returns.

name: call_table_entry_routine
description: Library routine that calls through a function pointer stored at a different fixed negative offset in a global table, then returns.

name: return_zero_at_entry
description: Entry routine of the library that does nothing but return zero.

name: store_two_values_in_struct
description: Library routine that writes two values from registers into a structure passed in a register, at two fixed offsets, then returns.

name: increment_counter_clear_flag
description: Library routine that increments a short counter in a structure and clears one bit of a flag byte in the same structure.

name: decrement_counter_and_call
description: Library routine that decrements a short counter in a structure and, when it reaches zero while a flag bit is set, calls another routine and returns its result, otherwise returning zero.

name: finish_or_mark_pending
description: Library routine that, when the counter is zero, calls two library functions through a table and returns a stored value; otherwise it sets a pending flag bit and returns zero.

name: get_value_after_two_calls
description: Library routine that reads a stored value from the structure passed in, makes two indirect library calls through a table, and returns the stored value.

name: return_zero_without_action
description: Routine that does nothing and returns zero.

name: create_handle_store_value
description: Entry routine that obtains a handle through a table call, stores the argument at a fixed offset when one is returned, calls a second table routine, and returns whether a handle was obtained.

name: store_value_in_handle
description: Library routine that obtains a handle through a table call and, when one is returned, stores the argument at a fixed offset in it and calls a second table routine. It returns whether a handle was obtained.

name: open_dos_and_graphics_libraries
description: Library initialize routine that opens dos.library and graphics.library through the library opener, initializes an empty list in the structure when both succeed, and otherwise releases the structure and returns zero.

name: close_library_and_free
description: Routine that closes a library base and frees the memory block passed in, then returns zero.

name: unload_unused_segment_entries
description: Library routine that walks a list of entries, unlinks each entry whose counter is not positive, unloads its segment through the dos library, and decrements a count in the structure.

name: release_idle_library_entry
description: Library routine that, when the structure has no users left, closes its library bases, unlinks it from its list, releases its memory and returns a stored value; otherwise it marks the entry as pending and returns zero.

name: mark_entry_pending
description: Routine that sets the high bit of a flag byte in the structure and returns zero.

name: return_without_action
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no operations.

name: clear_flag_and_increment_counter
description: Routine that clears the high bit of a flag byte in the structure and increments a short counter at a different offset.

name: decrement_counter_then_dispatch
description: Library routine that decrements a short counter in the structure and, when the counter is still nonzero and the flag's high bit is set, calls through a table and returns that result; otherwise it returns zero.

name: return_zero_result
description: Routine that returns zero and performs no other operations.

name: pack_font_entry_records
description: Library routine that walks a list of font entries, measures each name string, and writes packed records of the name and entry fields into a caller buffer while tracking the used length.

name: copy_font_entry_name_record
description: Library routine that reserves space in a buffer, copies the name bytes of a font entry, and writes a record with a constant tag and fields taken from the entry.

name: copy_font_name_bytes_loop
description: Library routine that copies name bytes one at a time into a buffer, writing a record each time the buffer fills, and advances through the entry list.

name: scan_fonts_directory_entries
description: Library routine that, when a flag bit is set, opens the FONTS directory through the dos library and scans its entries for names ending in .font, reading each matching entry.

name: read_font_file_header
description: Library routine that reads a four-byte header from a file through a library call, and when it carries the expected value reads one fixed-size block per counted entry.

name: read_font_records_from_file
description: Library routine that reads records from a file through the dos library, checks each header against an expected value, and reads a fixed-size block for each counted entry into a buffer.

name: read_font_entries_then_close
description: Library routine that reads font records through the dos library, stores matching entries in a buffer, and closes the file once all entries are processed.

name: unlock_and_return_magnitude
description: Library routine that unlocks a file lock through the dos library, makes a second library call, and returns the magnitude of its negative result, or zero when the result is not negative.

name: return_zero_constant
description: Routine that immediately returns zero without performing any other operations.

name: score_font_match_distance
description: Library routine that returns a match score for two font descriptors: a large negative sentinel when the first is unset, otherwise a size difference reduced by per-bit penalties from a global table.

name: subtract_style_bit_penalties
description: Library routine that starts from a base score and subtracts a penalty from a global table for each of seven flag bits that differ between two descriptors.

name: subtract_bit_group_penalties
description: Library routine that subtracts table penalties from a running score for each set bit that differs between two byte fields, walking seven bit positions.

name: subtract_alternate_bit_penalties
description: Library routine that subtracts table penalties from a running score for bits found in the second byte field, walking seven bit positions with a different bit pattern.

name: return_negative_sentinel
description: Routine that returns a fixed large negative sentinel value.

name: open_font_from_fonts_dir
description: Library routine that copies the eight-byte font descriptor onto the stack, then calls library functions with the FONTS path to locate and open the matching font file, returning the result.

name: load_font_file_entries
description: Library routine that opens a font file from the FONTS directory through the dos library, reads its header and records, and builds the font entries in memory.

name: select_best_scoring_font
description: Library routine that scores each font entry with a matching helper, selects the highest-scoring one, and updates it based on a value looked up from that entry.

name: load_and_register_font_segments
description: Library routine that finishes the best-match selection by loading font segments through the dos library, linking them into the list and adding each to the system font list.

name: unload_font_segments_and_return
description: Library routine that unloads a font segment through the dos library, clears its entry, cleans up the outstanding segments, and returns a stored value.

name: release_font_file_handles
description: Library routine that clears per-entry size fields in a font table, then closes the file handle and unlocks the lock held in the structure before returning a stored value.

name: forbid_task_switching
description: Routine that calls the exec forbid function, which stops task switching, and then returns.

name: permit_task_switching
description: Routine that calls the exec permit function to resume task switching, then returns.

name: allocate_memory_block
description: Routine that passes its arguments through to the exec memory allocation function via the library base.

name: free_memory_block
description: Routine that passes its arguments through to the exec memory release function via the library base.

name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Routine that copies bytes from a source pointer to a destination pointer until a zero byte has been copied.

name: append_string_via_helper
description: Routine that advances to the end of a zero-terminated string and passes that position and the second argument to a helper, appending to the string.

name: forward_string_copy_call
description: Wrapper routine that forwards its arguments to a helper that copies a string, then returns.

name: count_string_characters
description: Routine that counts the bytes of a zero-terminated string before its terminator and returns the count.

name: return_immediately
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no operations.

name: compare_strings_ordering
description: Routine that compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte and returns minus one, one or zero depending on their order.

name: compare_first_char_ordering
description: Routine that compares a stored byte with the first byte of a string and returns minus one when the stored byte is smaller, otherwise one.

name: find_char_in_string_forward
description: Routine that scans a zero-terminated string forward and returns a pointer to the first occurrence of the given character, or null when it is absent.

name: search_char_forward_registers
description: Routine that scans a zero-terminated string held in registers forward for a character and returns a pointer to it, or null when it is absent.

name: return_zero_status
description: Routine that returns zero and performs no other operations.

name: find_char_in_string_backward
description: Routine that measures a zero-terminated string and scans it backward for the given character, returning a pointer to its last occurrence or null when it is absent.

name: search_char_backward_bounded
description: Routine that steps backward through a byte range held in registers, returning a pointer to the first matching character or null once the range start is passed.

name: return_zero_default
description: Routine that returns zero and performs no other operations.

name: find_path_separator_or_start
description: Routine that looks for a slash or colon separator in a string and returns the pointer to the separator found, or the original string pointer when neither is present.

name: return_immediately
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no operations.

name: call_handler_and_return
description: Wrapper routine that calls one other routine and returns, with no other work of its own.

name: call_external_handler
description: Wrapper routine that calls one other routine and returns, with no other work of its own.

name: initialize_program_startup_state
description: Program entry routine that clears several global state variables, obtains a structure through a library call and, when a field in it is zero, marks an error state and calls helpers. It then opens further library bases in sequence.

name: release_display_and_workbench
description: Routine that releases the display copper lists and workbench connection, closes the libraries it opened, adjusts the task priority and writes the DMA control hardware register.

name: open_disk_file_with_retry
description: Routine that tries to lock a file name on disk, unlocks it and opens it, retrying in a counting delay loop until a deadline passes, and returns the handle when the file opens.

name: return_immediately
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no operations.

name: load_artwork_screen_or_fallback
description: Routine that calls a loader for the screen artwork named in the referenced path, and when the load fails it sets a flag and falls back to helper calls that prepare the display.

name: run_three_helpers_in_sequence
description: Routine that calls three other routines one after another and returns.

name: next_pseudo_random_value
description: Routine that advances a 16-bit seed stored in the structure with a multiplicative step and an increment, then returns the new value shifted right by the requested amount.

name: return_immediately
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no operations.

name: install_interrupt_handlers
description: Routine that clears timing globals and installs interrupt handler routines by writing their addresses into the interrupt vector table and adding interrupt servers through the exec library.

name: remove_interrupt_handlers_and_restore
description: Routine that removes the interrupt servers it installed, writes interrupt and DMA control register values to disable the channels, and restores the saved vector and state globals.

name: return_immediately
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no operations.

name: read_mouse_position_deltas
description: Routine that reads the mouse movement register and the fire-button port, computes the change in horizontal and vertical position since the last read, and accumulates clamped deltas in state bytes.

name: return_immediately
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no operations.

name: decode_keyboard_serial_code
description: Routine that decodes a keyboard serial byte, updates the shift state for two special codes, and stores the translated character in a ring buffer when the key-down bit is clear.

name: update_state_bit_value_two
description: Routine that sets or clears the bit with value two in a shared state word according to whether the high bit of the input is set.

name: update_state_bit_value_one
description: Routine that sets or clears the bit with value one in a shared state word according to whether the high bit of the input is set.

name: merge_bits_into_state
description: Routine that ORs a word passed in a register into a shared state word.

name: append_translated_key_to_buffer
description: Routine that, when the high bit of the input is clear, looks up a translated code from a table, adjusted by a flag, appends it to a ring buffer and advances the write index, wrapping at the limit.

name: check_key_buffer_empty
description: Routine that returns zero when the key ring buffer has no pending entries and minus one when it has.

name: wait_and_read_key_byte
description: Routine that waits until the key ring buffer has an entry, returns the next byte from it, and advances the read index, wrapping at the limit.

name: handle_audio_channel_zero_interrupt
description: Audio channel zero interrupt handler that acknowledges the channel's interrupt request, then either decrements a repeat counter and re-enables the channel's DMA, or disables that DMA and resets the counter to its maximum.

name: disable_audio_channel_zero_dma
description: Routine that decrements the repeat counter for audio channel zero and disables that channel's DMA.

name: handle_audio_channel_one_interrupt
description: Audio channel one interrupt handler that acknowledges the channel's interrupt request, then either decrements its repeat counter and re-enables the channel's DMA, or disables that DMA and resets the counter to its maximum.

name: disable_audio_channel_one_dma
description: Routine that decrements the repeat counter for audio channel one and disables that channel's DMA.

name: handle_audio_channel_two_interrupt
description: Audio channel two interrupt handler that acknowledges the channel's interrupt request, then either decrements its repeat counter and re-enables the channel's DMA, or disables that DMA and resets the counter to its maximum.

name: disable_audio_channel_two_dma
description: Routine that decrements the repeat counter for audio channel two and disables that channel's DMA.

name: handle_audio_channel_three_interrupt
description: Audio channel three interrupt handler that acknowledges the channel's interrupt request, then either decrements its repeat counter and re-enables the channel's DMA, or disables that DMA and resets the counter to its maximum.

name: disable_audio_channel_three_dma
description: Routine that decrements the repeat counter for audio channel three and disables that channel's DMA.

name: ramp_audio_channel_volumes

name: accumulate_elapsed_timer_ticks
description: Routine that reads the low timer byte of the CIA chip, computes the difference from the previous reading with wraparound, and adds the scaled difference to an elapsed-time counter.

name: allocate_even_sized_buffer_slice
description: Routine that rounds a requested size up to an even number, advances a buffer pointer by that amount when it stays within the buffer limit, and returns the previous position, or minus one when space is insufficient.

name: allocate_memory_with_retry
description: Routine that tries to allocate memory through the exec library and, while the allocation fails, decrements a budget in steps, frees resources and retries, returning a failure status once the budget is exhausted.

name: setup_display_color_structures

name: load_pit_background_artwork
description: Routine that, when its state flag is clear, loads the pit background artwork from the referenced disk path and resets the associated state values.

name: load_mirror_artwork
description: Routine that, when its state flag is clear, loads the mirror artwork from the referenced disk path and sets the state values to mark it as loaded.

name: reserve_table_slot_length

name: return_negative_one
description: Routine that returns minus one and performs no other operations.

name: load_sound_data_files
description: Routine that calls two helpers to load sound data from the referenced disk path and, when a flag is set, makes two further helper calls.

name: load_sound_data_part_two
description: Routine that, when a flag is set, makes two helper calls to load the second sound data set from the referenced disk path.

name: relocate_sound_table_entries
description: Routine that loads the third sound data set from the referenced disk path through a helper, then adds a base address to every third longword of a thirty-entry table, relocating its pointers.

name: relocate_sound_table_pointers
description: Routine that adds its own base address to every third longword of a thirty-entry table, relocating the stored pointers.

name: subtract_bias_from_bytes
description: Routine that calls a helper to obtain a length, subtracts 128 from each byte of a buffer of that length, and then calls a further helper.

name: seek_read_and_close_file
description: Routine that obtains a value from a helper and, when it is nonzero, records it, seeks within the file, reads through the dos library and closes the file, returning the read result; otherwise it returns minus one.

name: seek_and_read_file_pair
description: Routine that obtains a value from a helper and, when it is nonzero, records it, performs three seeks in the file, reads a block and closes the file, returning the values read.

name: return_immediately
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no operations.

name: load_demo_lap_file
description: Routine that obtains a file handle through a helper and, when it is valid, reads from the file twice and closes it, returning zero; otherwise it returns minus one. The referenced path names the demo lap file.

name: load_high_score_table
description: Routine that opens the high score table file through a helper, reads its records, closes it and runs a further helper, returning zero on success or minus one when the file cannot be opened.

name: save_high_score_table
description: Routine that opens the high score table file through a helper and writes its contents, writing a second block when the first byte is an asterisk, then closes it and returns zero, or minus one when opening fails.

name: xor_scramble_data_block
description: Routine that exclusive-ors each of the 220 bytes of a buffer with a fixed key value, applying a simple reversible scramble.

name: read_twelve_file_fields
description: Routine that obtains a file handle through a helper and, when valid, performs twelve sequential reads through the dos library, then closes the file and returns zero; otherwise it returns minus one.

name: read_nine_file_fields
description: Routine that obtains a file handle through a helper and, when valid, performs nine sequential reads through the dos library, then closes the file and returns zero; otherwise it returns minus one.

name: read_counted_offset_table
description: Routine that obtains a file handle through a helper, reads a header, then reads a counted table of entries adding a base value to each, followed by two counted read loops, and closes the file; it returns minus one when the file cannot be opened.

name: copy_padded_bob_name
description: Routine that copies the seven-character name from an eight-byte record into a fixed buffer, turning spaces into zero bytes, then obtains a value from a helper and stores it in a table slot.

name: store_helper_result_in_slot
description: Routine that obtains a value from a helper and stores it in the table slot selected by the index argument, when that index is nonnegative.

name: copy_padded_name_and_load
description: Routine that copies the seven-character name from an eight-byte record into a fixed buffer, turning spaces into zero bytes, then calls a helper with it.

name: load_bob_library_entries
description: Large routine that loads the bob artwork library from the referenced disk path, calling a helper once for each entry while each result is nonnegative, and closes the file at the end.

name: load_top_racer_frames
description: Routine that computes a state value as the difference of two stored positions, then loads the top racer frame graphics named in the referenced paths and returns the loader result.

name: load_inset_graphic
description: Routine that stores the difference of two stored positions and then loads the inset graphic named in the referenced path, keeping the loader result.
